description: Unofficial Pennywise fan-art companion inspired by the 2017 IT clown appearance. A friendly toy-like adaptation with gray-white ruffles, orange hair and a tethered red balloon. Original actions include tying a loose bow, revealing a paper-star card, polite stage bows and small articulated runs and jumps. Calm nonthreatening presentation with no horror or injury imagery; not affiliated with the original creators.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
